brief.meaningEn: Fewer separate elements that must be coordinated for a plan to work.
brief.meaningZh: 計劃中需要互相配合的獨立環節較少。
brief.grammar: A plan has fewer moving parts; plural moving parts is a mechanical metaphor for coordination complexity.
brief.register: Project planning: a volunteer coordinator compares two ways to distribute supplies under a deadline.
brief.boundaryZh: 環節較少通常較易協調，但不保證計劃較好或完全沒有風險。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是比較真正會移動的零件數，也不能忽略簡化後可能失去的服務。
brief.outcomeZh: 能找出要協調的獨立環節，並區分簡化與品質保證。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 83, row 2; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The simpler plan has fewer moving parts.

listening.en: The first plan needs three vans, four suppliers and two booking systems. The second uses one supplier and one collection point, so it has fewer moving parts.
listening.zh: 第一個計劃需要三輛貨車、四個供應商和兩套預約系統；第二個只用一個供應商和一個領取點，因此需要協調的環節較少。
listening.promptZh: fewer moving parts 在這裏表示甚麼？

options.en: Fewer separate elements to coordinate.
options.zh: 需要協調的獨立環節較少。

options.en: Fewer physical wheels on the vans.
options.zh: 貨車的實際車輪較少。

options.en: A guarantee that the second plan will succeed.
options.zh: 保證第二個計劃會成功。

options.en: No services will be provided.
options.zh: 不會提供任何服務。

listening.explanationZh: 供應商和領取點減少，指協調複雜度下降。

reply.promptEn: Why did the school choose one sign-up form? The alternative required parents to complete separate forms for the club, bus and lunch team, which then had to reconcile records.
reply.promptZh: （學校為何選擇一份報名表？另一方案要求家長分別為學會、校巴和午膳組填表，之後還要核對紀錄。）

options.en: One form reduces the number of systems to coordinate.
options.zh: 一份表減少了要協調的系統數目。

options.en: Staff have fewer separate records to reconcile.
options.zh: 職員要核對的不同紀錄較少。

options.en: The one-form plan has fewer moving parts.
options.zh: 一份表的方案需要協調的環節較少。

options.en: The chosen process is simpler to administer.
options.zh: 所選流程較易管理。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均根據表格及核對工作減少；金句用 fewer moving parts。

scene.promptZh: 展覽可用一個報到台，或四個台加上每天同步名單；其他條件相同。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The one-desk plan has fewer moving parts.
options.zh: 一個報到台的方案需要協調的環節較少。

options.en: The one-desk plan has fewer literal machine parts.
options.zh: 一個報到台有較少真正的機械零件。

options.en: The one-desk plan guarantees no queues.
options.zh: 一個報到台保證沒有隊伍。

scene.explanationZh: 減少報到台和名單同步，協調環節較少；仍可能排隊。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個方案最不支持「較少環節」？

options.en: One team records bookings in one shared list.
options.zh: 一隊人把預約記在一份共用名單。

options.en: Five teams use separate lists and call one another daily to reconcile them.
options.zh: 五隊人各用不同名單，每天通話核對。

options.en: One desk handles check-in without another handoff.
options.zh: 一個櫃台完成登記，毋須另行交接。

contrast.explanationZh: 多隊、多份名單與每日核對增加協調環節。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「方案有 fewer moving parts，就一定最好。」你怎樣回應？

options.en: Fewer moving parts can reduce coordination work, but we still need to check whether people get the service they need.
options.zh: 較少環節可減少協調工作，但仍須檢查服務是否滿足需要。

options.en: Simplicity guarantees quality in every case.
options.zh: 簡單在任何情況都保證品質。

options.en: The phrase refers only to machine repair.
options.zh: 這片語只指維修機器。

dialogue.explanationZh: 簡化不自動代表服務充分。

speaking.en: The clinic chose one shared appointment list because it had fewer moving parts than sending patients through three separate desks.
speaking.zh: 診所選一份共用預約名單，因為這比讓病人經過三個不同櫃台有較少協調環節。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出哪些交接被減少。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：校園捐書活動原方案由三個小組各自收書並每天合併名單；新方案改為單一收集點及一份共用名單，但仍要核對遺失書籍。用一至兩句英文比較協調環節，勿保證零失誤。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出三組及每日合併名單、新方案單一收集點與共用名單，以及仍需核對遺失書籍。

examples.en: The one-point collection plan with a shared list has fewer moving parts than three teams merging lists daily, though volunteers still need to check for missing books.
examples.zh: 單一收集點及共用名單的方案，比三組每天合併名單需要協調的環節較少，但義工仍須核對有沒有遺失書籍。

examples.en: With one collection point and a shared list, the book drive has fewer moving parts than the three-team system with daily merged lists; staff must still check for missing books.
examples.zh: 捐書活動改用一個收集點和共用名單後，比每天合併名單的三組制度需要協調的環節較少；職員仍須核對遺失書籍。

takeaways.en: Fewer moving parts means fewer elements to coordinate.
takeaways.zh: 較少需要協調的環節，指獨立配合事項較少。

takeaways.en: A plan with fewer moving parts can still need careful checks.
takeaways.zh: 環節較少的計劃，仍可能需要仔細核對。

brief.meaningEn: During the near future while longer-term arrangements may be different.
brief.meaningZh: 在較近的未來一段時間內，往後安排可能不同。
brief.grammar: In the short term is a time adverbial often set off by a comma at sentence start; contrast with in the long term.
brief.register: Work planning: a team leader explains temporary staffing needs while permanent recruitment continues.
brief.boundaryZh: 短期並無固定天數，須依情境說明；不能把短期措施誤說成永久解決。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是指一個「短學期」；也不能忽略句中長遠安排。
brief.outcomeZh: 能把近期需要與較長遠方案分開說清楚。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 83, row 3; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: In the short term, the team needs extra support.

listening.en: The team needs two temporary assistants this month while it recruits permanent staff. In the short term, extra support will keep the desk open.
listening.zh: 團隊本月需要兩名臨時助理，同時招聘正式職員。短期內，額外人手可令櫃台繼續服務。
listening.promptZh: In the short term 在這裏表示甚麼？

options.en: For the near future, while recruitment continues.
options.zh: 在招聘持續期間的近期。

options.en: For the rest of time without change.
options.zh: 永遠不再改變。

options.en: During a short school semester.
options.zh: 在短學期期間。

options.en: Only after permanent staff have arrived.
options.zh: 只在正式職員到任後。

listening.explanationZh: 臨時支援應對本月需要，正式招聘仍在進行。

reply.promptEn: Why is the library borrowing staff from another branch this month? Its new permanent posts will not be filled until later, but the reading room must stay open now.
reply.promptZh: （圖書館為何本月向另一分館借調職員？新的長期職位較後才會填補，但閱覽室現在必須維持開放。）

options.en: Borrowed staff cover the immediate gap.
options.zh: 借調職員填補眼前空缺。

options.en: The permanent posts remain the later solution.
options.zh: 長期職位仍是往後方案。

options.en: In the short term, borrowed staff can keep the room open.
options.zh: 短期內，借調職員可維持閱覽室開放。

options.en: The library needs help before recruitment finishes.
options.zh: 圖書館在招聘完成前需要協助。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均區分眼前支援與日後招聘；金句用 in the short term。

scene.promptZh: 學校本月先租用流動課室，明年才建成新教室。哪句最貼切？

options.en: In the short term, the mobile room provides space.
options.zh: 短期內，流動課室提供空間。

options.en: The mobile room is definitely the permanent solution.
options.zh: 流動課室一定是永久方案。

options.en: Short term means the shortest school semester.
options.zh: short term 指最短的學期。

scene.explanationZh: 流動課室應對近期，永久教室明年才落成。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句最正確區分兩個時段？

options.en: In the short term, use temporary tutors; in the long term, train permanent staff.
options.zh: 短期用臨時導師；長遠培訓正式職員。

options.en: In the short term means the plan can never change.
options.zh: 短期表示計劃永遠不能改。

options.en: In the short term only refers to yesterday.
options.zh: 短期只指昨天。

contrast.explanationZh: 近期措施與長遠方案分明。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「既然短期有臨時員工，往後就不需要招聘。」你怎樣回應？

options.en: In the short term, temporary staff help; permanent recruitment may still be needed later.
options.zh: 短期內臨時員工有幫助，往後仍可能需要正式招聘。

options.en: Short-term help automatically solves every future staffing need.
options.zh: 短期支援自動解決將來所有人手需要。

options.en: The phrase means temporary staff have already left.
options.zh: 這片語表示臨時員工已離開。

dialogue.explanationZh: 近期措施不等於長遠問題已解決。

speaking.en: In the short term, the centre will extend two volunteer shifts while it searches for a permanent receptionist.
speaking.zh: 短期內，中心會延長兩更義工輪值，同時尋找正式接待員。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出當前和長遠的人手安排。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社區診所的新正式護士要兩個月後才到任；本月由鄰近診所借調護士，確保晚間門診照常開放。用一至兩句英文區分短期做法與長遠人手。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出本月借調、晚間門診維持開放、正式護士兩個月後到任。

examples.en: In the short term, the clinic will borrow a nurse this month to keep evening appointments open; its permanent nurse arrives in two months.
examples.zh: 短期內，診所本月會借調護士，維持晚間門診；正式護士兩個月後到任。

examples.en: The permanent nurse starts in two months, so in the short term a borrowed nurse will cover this month’s evening clinic.
examples.zh: 正式護士兩個月後上班，因此短期內會由借調護士負責本月晚間門診。

takeaways.en: In the short term identifies a near-future period, not a fixed number of days.
takeaways.zh: 短期內指近期一段時間，沒有固定日數。

takeaways.en: In the short term, a temporary fix can coexist with a permanent plan.
takeaways.zh: 短期措施可與長遠計劃並存。

brief.meaningEn: Act or make a decision alone rather than with a partner or group.
brief.meaningZh: 不與搭檔或團隊一起，而是獨自進行或作決定。
brief.grammar: Go solo after decide/prefer/choose to; solo may describe action or independent decision-making, not a music performance necessarily.
brief.register: Informal planning: a student tells a teammate that she will draft her own optional poster but collaborate on the shared exhibition.
brief.boundaryZh: 獨自完成一項工作，不代表永遠拒絕合作或完全沒有外部協助。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不一定是歌手獨唱；也不要把「自行決定」誤說成「沒有人給任何建議」。
brief.outcomeZh: 能說明哪項工作或決定獨自處理，並界定合作仍在哪裏存在。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 83, row 14; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: For a small choice, I prefer to go solo.

listening.en: Mira asked for advice about the poster, but she chose its final design herself rather than join the design team. For that small choice, she preferred to go solo.
listening.zh: 米拉曾徵詢海報意見，但她不加入設計組，而是自行決定最終設計。這項小決定，她較想獨自進行。
listening.promptZh: go solo 在這裏表示甚麼？

options.en: Make that design choice independently.
options.zh: 獨自作出該項設計決定。

options.en: Refuse to hear any advice at all.
options.zh: 完全拒絕聽取任何意見。

options.en: Perform a song alone on stage.
options.zh: 獨自在台上唱歌。

options.en: Stop working on every shared activity.
options.zh: 停止參與所有共同活動。

listening.explanationZh: 她聽了建議，但最終選擇自己決定。

reply.promptEn: Why is Omar writing the optional book review by himself? The group is still building its shared display, but each pupil may choose how to write an individual reflection.
reply.promptZh: （奧馬為何獨自寫額外的書評？小組仍共同製作展板，但每名學生可自行決定怎樣寫個人感想。）

options.en: The optional reflection is Omar’s individual choice.
options.zh: 額外感想由奧馬個人決定。

options.en: He can write this part without a partner.
options.zh: 這部分他可以不找搭檔。

options.en: Omar decided to go solo on the book review.
options.zh: 奧馬決定獨自撰寫書評。

options.en: The shared display remains group work.
options.zh: 共同展板仍由小組製作。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都界定獨自處理書評，而非退出所有小組工作。

scene.promptZh: 攝影師聽過同事建議後，自行決定個人作品的編排；團體展覽仍一起籌備。哪句最貼切？

options.en: She chose to go solo on the personal layout while joining the group exhibition.
options.zh: 她獨自處理個人作品編排，仍參與團體展覽。

options.en: She never spoke to a colleague.
options.zh: 她從未跟同事交談。

options.en: She stopped taking part in every group task.
options.zh: 她停止參與所有團體工作。

scene.explanationZh: 個人編排獨立，團體展覽仍合作。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不足以說 go solo？

options.en: A writer drafts her own chapter after discussing the outline with the team.
options.zh: 作家和團隊討論大綱後，獨自寫自己的章節。

options.en: Two partners jointly approve every line of their shared proposal.
options.zh: 兩名搭檔共同批准提案每一行。

options.en: A student chooses the final colour scheme for his individual poster.
options.zh: 學生自行選個人海報的最終配色。

contrast.explanationZh: 每行都共同決定，不是獨自處理。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「她 go solo，所以一定不會接受任何建議。」你怎樣回應？

options.en: Going solo can mean making the final choice alone while still listening to suggestions.
options.zh: 獨自決定可以包括聽取建議，最後由自己作選擇。

options.en: Anyone who goes solo must avoid every conversation.
options.zh: 獨自進行的人必須避免所有對話。

options.en: The phrase only refers to singing.
options.zh: 這片語只指獨唱。

dialogue.explanationZh: 獨立決策不等於隔絕意見。

speaking.en: I will go solo on the optional sketch, but we will still build the main model together.
speaking.zh: 額外草圖我會獨自完成，但主要模型我們仍會一起製作。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出獨自與合作的兩部分。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社區海報比賽容許個人參賽。嘉雯聽取朋友的配色建議後，決定自己製作參賽海報；她仍與朋友一起籌辦頒獎禮。用一至兩句英文說明獨自處理的範圍。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出聽取配色建議、獨自製作海報、仍一起籌辦頒獎禮。

examples.en: After hearing colour suggestions, Ka-man chose to go solo on her competition poster, while still helping her friends organise the awards ceremony.
examples.zh: 嘉雯聽取配色建議後，決定獨自製作參賽海報，但仍與朋友一起籌辦頒獎禮。

examples.en: Ka-man will go solo when making her own poster, although she heard friends’ colour advice and will work with them on the awards event.
examples.zh: 嘉雯製作自己的海報時會獨自進行，雖然她聽取了朋友的配色意見，仍會與他們一起籌辦頒獎活動。

takeaways.en: Go solo identifies an action or decision handled independently.
takeaways.zh: 獨自進行要指出哪項行動或決定由一人處理。

takeaways.en: Going solo on one task does not rule out teamwork elsewhere.
takeaways.zh: 一項工作獨自處理，不排除其他工作仍然合作。
